# Didero

Didero is a Software Development company. Didero is an AI procurement agent that executes direct spend workflows across procurement, supply chain, and finance on top of the systems you already use. built for the physical economy. Didero employs 37 people (+105.6% YoY, +19 people). Headquartered in New York, New York, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Philippines, and Canada.

## About

Didero is the AI execution layer for physical spend.

Our AI agents sit on top of your ERP, turn demand and inventory signals into purchasing action, and chase suppliers so your team doesn't have to.

Manufacturers and distributors use Didero to cut costs, move faster, and stay ahead of a trade landscape that changes weekly.

We're hiring!
